title: nazm.diagnostic-detail/1
description: One current diagnostic in full, from `nazm diagnostics --detail ID --state DIGEST --json` and the `nazm-mcp` tool `nazm.diagnostic_detail`: the diagnostic exactly as `nazm.diagnostic/1` publishes it — the compiler's prose, unchanged — with its places in their own files, its owning definition, and for each compiler fix the `nazm.semantic_patch` request that plans it where N29 can. Refused as `stale_state` unless the sources are exactly the index's state, so an id never selects another diagnostic.

reason.description: `stale_state`: the sources are not the state the id came from. `no_such_diagnostic`: no current diagnostic has that id. Present only when `status` is `unavailable`.

diagnostic.description: The diagnostic as `nazm.diagnostic/1` publishes it, less its `schema` field: that schema defines every field, and its spans are offsets into the concatenation of the compilation's files.

locations.description: `diagnostic`'s spans, each in its own root-relative file with UTF-8 byte offsets, in the same order; null for a span with no place.

facts.description: Typed expected/actual facts: the compiler records none for any diagnostic, and none is read from prose.

compiler_fixes.description: How many fixes the compiler attached.

semantic_patches.description: How many of them N29 can plan — never more than `compiler_fixes`, and none for a compilation without a snapshot, such as any with a syntax error.

semantic_patch.description: The `diagnostic_fix` request that plans this fix with `nazm.semantic_patch` / `nazm patch fix` — a selector, not a plan. Null where N29 cannot plan it.
